<!-- pr-reviewer: effe8ea86403cb10632ac1a7530cf8a4c28475f4 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** Docs-only (3 files under `site/content/guide/`), `mergeable` is MERGEABLE, so nothing was built; I checked the page against `origin/main`.

**What looks good**
- Refusal text matches the code: `wire_op.rs` (machine, condition, gap, bottom-below-top), `commands/operation/gates.rs:143-151` (mount a wire EDM / wire EDM cuts only wire EDM operations), `motion/src/wire_edm/{ring,laws,mod}.rs` (crossing, no area, too small, neck, slot, inside corner, start hole refusals), "not built yet" and "verified by the wire laws" in the posting and stock-sim code.
- Seed defaults agree with `seed_wire_contour` (Die, no start hole, top/bottom from the model, empty condition); tab placement and labels agree with `wire_page.rs` (Side and Start hole on Geometry, planes on Heights, Condition on Passes).
- One kind in the group, sinker and unmerged skims/tabs/taper left out, as the body says. Front matter and `@/guide/...` links point at pages on main (refusals, troubleshooting, machines, operations). Plain English, no HSMWorks material, no Rust, build, dependency or process-file changes, no snapshots, no CHANGELOG edit. Body has `Refs #1250`, `Changelog: none`.

**Local results:** not built (docs-only); no tests or clippy needed.

**Requested before merge:** none.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The "0 / 0 when first ticked" start-hole default and the "is wire EDM work ..." wording in the mill-refusal quote were not traced to a single line; both read consistent with the seed and gates code.
- The `zola build` result in the PR body was not re-run here.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- review-cost: effe8ea86403cb10632ac1a7530cf8a4c28475f4 -->
**Estimated agent cost to merge-ready:** ~$0.22 (79k tokens)
| Run | Model | Tokens | Est. cost |
|---|---|---|---|
| review | Sonnet 5.5 | 79k | ~$0.22 |
Blended upper estimate (90 % input / 10 % output at list price; cache reads make the real cost lower). Main-session coordination and runs from other sessions are not counted.
Effort: effort:high
